description: Report a bug, request a feature, ask a question, or flag a security issue with Clarvia or any indexed tool. Use when you encounter problems with a tool's AEO score, find incorrect data, want to suggest improvements to the Clarvia platform, or discover a security vulnerability. Creates a tracked ticket that the Clarvia team will address.
